g.text: Retrospective, in-sample comparisons among complete households: identification is relative to the observed contacts, and no schedule is claimed optimal. Right panel: World Bank 2021, 'hungry but did not eat'

g.text: negatives at the January round; the logistic model was trained on 2020 rounds only and matches the simple count rule.
